name: Hold The Door
description:
Buy your team a few more seconds.
Right-click a closed, unlocked, unbarricaded door and choose Hold It to brace it with your body. The door gains temporary HP while you hold it.
Choose Let Go, move, run, aim, or cancel the action to release. You cannot open or lock doors while holding. If the held door breaks, you fall down.
Door HP Multiplier is configurable in Sandbox Options. Supports ordinary and player-built single doors; garage and multi-panel doors are excluded.
Languages: English and Simplified Chinese.
